items.text: Hello Survivors,
Today, we’re bringing you a small hotfix to smooth out a few issues in the new Realm and keep your Endless Mode runs going as intended.
✅ Events in the new Realm’s Endless Mode now spawn correctly after the 20-minute mark, instead of quietly vanishing into oblivion.
✅ Added a separate volume control for ambient sounds, so you can adjust the atmosphere without changing the rest of the game’s audio.
✅ Bosses in the Realm of Hades’ Endless Mode now spawn correctly. Their holidays are officially over ːsteamsadː

We have collected several solutions that have already worked for other players in this Steam thread: https://steamcommunity.com/app/2922410/discussions/0/571542958702190353/. Disabling Intel AI Boost appears to be the most commonly reported fix, so we recommend trying that first.
Thank you for the warm reception of Update 1.6, and for sending us your reports so quickly. We're lucky to have such a great community ːluckofachillesː
Please keep letting us know if you encounter any issues. As always, we’re reading all your feedback!
~ Dark Point Games Team
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45195884/865f872290d2c699cf141a9be6a7e4e467e0c4a6.jpg"]
Hello, Survivors!
In Greek myths, going home is rarely straightforward.
There is usually a god, a curse, a monster - or all three - waiting on the way.
Update 1.6 follows that tradition quite faithfully.
This time, we bring you two things we are especially happy about: Odysseus joins Achilles: Survivor in a new FREE DLC, and Tartarus opens as the biggest Realm we have added since launch.
So let us begin where all good trouble should begin: with a hero.
Sing in me, Muse, and through me tell the story
of that man skilled in all ways of contending,
the wanderer, harried for years on end.

notes.title: \[FREE DLC] New Survivor - Odysseus, the King of Ithaca

items.text: Some heroes win by strength.
Odysseus prefers a plan that goes wrong for everybody else first.
[dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/4844140/Achilles_Survivor__Odysseus_The_King_of_Ithaca/"]

Fresh from the Odyssey and the world of Greek mythology, Odysseus joins Achilles: Survivor as a swift Marksman with high mobility. He is a great fit for players who like keeping enemies at a distance - and making sure they regret chasing them.
There is time for many words, and there is also time for many arrows. ~Homer, probably
His Power, Odysseus’ Bow, fires a strong triple shot - one main arrow and two supporting arrows - letting you punish anything bold enough to approach you.
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45195884/775524e057e035884fd86e3884be4993c9d286cb.gif"]
His Talent, Marksman’s Trap, rewards movement by leaving behind a deadly turret trap once its bar is charged.
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45195884/01af239f4b4f66b97b8e135bbfed4a04d826c839.gif"]
He is free for all players, and we really recommend trying him out - with his short cooldowns, he feels refreshingly dynamic on the battlefield.
Escaping the Dungeons and defeating Hades was apparently not enough.
He has returned in his usual underhanded style and pulled the Survivors into a dreadful new Realm now fully under his control.
Old contender, will you not yield to the immortal gods?

This is the biggest content addition we have made since launch, and if you were hoping for a calmer summer holiday destination, we regret to inform you that Greek mythology has disappointed you once again.
Tartarus brings a darker, harsher stretch of the journey, with 5 locations and an Endless version, along with new enemies and bosses.
The new Realm introduces new encounters, bringing threats that may feel familiar from Achilles: Legends Untold into a much less forgiving environment.

notes.title: Among the Mid-Bosses, you will face

items.text: Griffin and Cyclops, returning in harsher forms from the world of the dead

notes.title: The Realm also features two major boss encounters

items.text: Phobos and Scorpion King, now reborn in a fearsome underworld form
So yes - if you had unfinished business with either of them, fate has kindly arranged a rematch.
There will be killing till the score is paid.

notes.title: 🔊 Ambient sounds added to all Realms

items.text: All Realms now start with ambient background audio to make each location feel more distinct. Ancient Greece should sound a little more alive - especially when it is trying to kill you
By hook or by crook this peril too shall be something that we remember.

notes.title: 💥 Explosive enemies deal slightly less damage

items.text: Your favourite explosive enemies are still dangerous, but their blasts should now feel a bit less punishing.
You still should not stand next to them on purpose. We feel this is important to clarify.
We really hope you enjoy this Odyssey-themed update.

notes.title: A few more things are happening on our side too

items.text: Achilles: Legends Untold received a small but heartfelt update…
and Achilles: Survivor is now getting this, our biggest update in quite a while.
But most importantly, our entire team is going to see the Odyssey in less than two weeks!!
τέτλαθι δή, κραδίη: καὶ κύντερον ἄλλο ποτ᾽ ἔτλης.
-and if you are going to see the Odyssey, tell us on our Discord
See you on the battlefield,
~Dark Point Games Team

topNew: Odysseus prefers a plan that goes wrong for everybody else first.

items.text: Hello, Survivors!

Update 1.5 is here, and this one brings a bit of everything: a new optional DLC Survivor for players who enjoy summon builds, three new Powers available to everyone, two new Structures, a brand-new attribute for ally-focused playstyles, and a much less stubborn path to Rebirth.
And since many of you have been sharing feedback about the early game, we also wanted to give you more interesting choices right from the start.
Let’s begin with the optional part - and then move straight to the free additions for everyone else.

notes.title: \ A new Survivor joins the roster

items.text: For those of you who enjoy spellcasting, summon builds, and the general fantasy of solving problems by arriving with your own army, we’ve added a brand-new playable Survivor: Skeleton King, the Cursed Necromancer.
He is built around commanding the dead - and letting his loyal subjects do the dangerous part of the job.
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45195884/f33b8d1cb01e91c85366acb409d8f18cb372cd19.gif"]

His Power, Necromantic Pulse, lets him raise skeletal allies during battle, so the longer the fight goes on, the less alone he is. His Talent, Necromantic Shield, turns that growing army into defense as well - surrounding him with spinning bone shields based on the number of summons he controls, pushing enemies back and boosting his survivability.
If you decide to pick him up, that also helps support our studio and lets us keep making more updates like this one, which we appreciate more than any undead monarch ever will.
[dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/4651480/Achilles_Survivor__The_Cursed_Necromancer/"]If summon builds are not your thing, no worries - the rest of Update 1.5 is for everyone.

We’ve seen a lot of feedback that the beginning of the game can sometimes take a little too long to properly start being fun. So with Update 1.5, we wanted to give the early game a bit more diversity. That is why all three new Powers below are available right away from the start.
For once, hesitating may improve your odds.

As you move, cursed blades build up. The moment you stop, they fire in a volley at the nearest enemies - one blade per target, up to a base maximum stack of 10. It gives you a new reason to think about positioning and turns every short pause into a sharp little counterattack.
Available from the start of the game.
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45195884/1888e7da90c564cea40c0fcc06a2b0d206bd5061.gif"]
If death himself cannot join your run, he can at least lend you the equipment.

Thanatos’ Scythes summons deadly scythes around your Survivor. They orbit you, spiral outward, and deal damage on contact, giving you a strong new option for players who like close-range pressure and constant movement.
Available from the start of the game.
This one is exactly what it sounds like, which is part of the appeal.

Wall of Blades creates a circular fence of swords around your Survivor. It’s a practical solution for enemies with boundary issues. Each sword damages the first enemy it touches and then shatters, which means the wall slowly opens up and creates gaps. It gives you strong protection at first, but it does not stay perfect forever.
Available from the start of the game.
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45195884/23093bd3f0854982823fdaf59b88b7c74975cc70.gif"]
Sometimes a run goes badly.
Now you get one second chance.

Shrine of Resurrection grants a one-time revival if your Survivor falls, bringing you back with 50% Health. Once it saves you, it is destroyed for the rest of that run, so this is not immortality - just a very welcome piece of insurance.
If you enjoy killing enemies and then profiting from it, we have good news.

Soul Well is a sacrificial structure. Defeat enemies around it to fill the circle, just like you would do with a chest, and once it is complete, the Well destroys itself and spits out rewards - including, if fortune smiles on you, a powerful allied mid-boss for a short time.
You can now earn yourself some very large friends.
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45195884/3b76ba5ed83ded2ff8cf3938c93faa365ff7b2ae.gif"]
Summon-focused builds now have a proper stat to grow into.

Summon Damage is a brand-new attribute dedicated to allies and summons. New level-up cards can increase it during runs, and you can also buy those upgrades in the Workshop. In short: if your build relies on minions, they can now hit much harder.
We have made Rebirth much easier to reach.
From now on, Rebirth unlocks after maxing out 5 Favours instead of all of them. That means significantly less grind and a much faster path to this endgame system.
We also adjusted the achievement tied to Rebirth.
It is now awarded after you actually use Rebirth, rather than when the option merely becomes available. That should make the requirement much clearer and more consistent with the other achievements.

PS: our game designer claims this is the final version of the Rebirth changes. Are we choosing to trust him? Jokes aside, we apologise for multiple changes - sometimes it takes time to find a good solution. We hope these adjustments finally make the mechanic feel much more rewarding without asking for quite so much patience first.

notes.title: Hello from Toruń, city of gingerbread

items.text: As always, thank you for playing, thank you for leaving feedback, and thank you for being honest with us when something feels great - or when it very much does not. A lot of these changes you see in our announcements start exactly there.
Spring has fully arrived here in Toruń, which means... it's cold and surprisingly rainy. We, meanwhile, are here adding skeletons, scythes, and second chances to the game.
Which feels like a fair use of May.
Let us know what do you think about new Powers and Structures - we’re curious which one will be the most popular
See you on the battlefield,
~ Dark Point Games Team
If you’ve read this far, Pythia offers you a small reward: a glimpse of what awaits in the next update. A new (and free) Survivor is coming - and yes, you already know his name.

releases.displayName: Mini-update: We bring you Easter Treats and April Tricks

items.text: Hello, Survivors!

notes.title: It’s time for the most important holiday of the year*.

items.text: We’re wishing you a calm Easter weekend - and a mildly cursed April Fools week!
🥚 To celebrate for the next week, regular chests might behave… strangely. We won’t spoil it. Just open a few and see what our local Chick… Rooster God has been up to.
🐣 There is one “treat” we can reveal: chests can now roll a Poison Cloud effect - and this one is staying in the game even after the event ends.

🐥 And a small but important change: one of the achievements no longer requires you to actually use Rebirth. From now on, it’s enough to meet the requirements to perform Rebirth (for those of you who prefer to keep your progress intact or just don’t find the mechanic appealing).
🐔 If you get a chest surprise that made you smile, please let our design team know in the comments. They had a lot of fun coming up with ideas and would love to see your reactions!

notes.title: Happy Easter, and happy April Fools!

items.text: All the best from Toruń from yours truly
~Dark Point Games team
*Based on a rigorous study conducted on a research group consisting of exactly one Alectryon.
[p align="start"]Hello, Survivors!
[p align="start"]Everybody likes to tell the story of Theseus and the Labyrinth.
Update 1.4 starts a different tale: the monster is out, it’s angry, and it’s looking for a fight.

[p align="start"]And since you have been sending us a steady stream of feedback, we also added 2 most requested languages, rebalanced Rebirth a bit, and even added some fun stuff to the game. Let’s get started.

notes.title: [dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/4315660/Achilles_Survivor__The_Beast_of_the_Labyrinth/"]\ New Survivor - Become the Beast of the Labyrinth

items.text: [p align="start"]If you ever read the myth and thought “fine, but what about the Minotaur?” - we have something for you.
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45195884/5d9c253c6e737e24bd07662034948347ea8ffeb8.gif"]
Minotaur is a Warrior built to stay in the middle of the fight. His kit rewards you for standing your ground in the melee instead of running away.
His unique power, Heavy Stomp, allows him to slam the ground and crush nearby enemies with the full weight of his hooves.
Thanks to his talent, once you defeat 150 enemies using melee powers, a furious spectral echo is summoned, charging forward and trampling everything in its path.
His bonus stats: +450 Max Health, +25% Melee Damage, +20% Critical Damage make him even more formidable fighter.
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45195884/37d489c68d517280af5930b32f664bed1ca3b7b2.gif"]

If you’re in the mood to try something different from your usual runs, the Minotaur is a fun excuse to do it. He’s our biggest Survivor yet - literally! - a towering wall of muscle and horns that changes the feel of melee play instantly. If that sounds fun to you, the DLC is now available on Steam:
[p align="start"]But of course, there is something for everyone in our new update:

[p align="start"]A high-HP structure (limited to 1 build at a time) that sends out an expanding pulse to damage nearby enemies, and heals you for 10% of the damage dealt (you don’t need to stand in its range to get healed).
[p align="start"]If it gets destroyed, it returns to your build pool so you can roll it again later.
[p align="start"]A heavy, frontal axe combo that hits in a quick 3-swing sequence (left-to-right, right-to-left, then a finishing swing) in front of your Survivor, perfect for melee-first builds.
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45195884/282cf338ededd785f2b79f587ac0aed7fd49c8a0.gif"]
[p align="start"]A new chest/shop item that gives you a temporary Armor boost when you need to survive the ugly part of the run.

notes.title: ✨ New Transformation for Battering Ram: “You Shall Not Pass”

items.text: [p align="start"]Unlock a new transformation that reflects incoming projectiles, making ranged waves far less annoying (and a lot more satisfying).
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45195884/772ddd184d5855b3656c0c66a10da2b10fa97f56.gif"]
[p align="start"]Two of the most requested languages are now fully supported:
Traditional Chinese
Turkish
[p align="start"]Welcome to the battlefield, Survivors!

notes.title: Rebirth now feels better, faster with new improvements

items.text: New Powers after Rebirth now appear earlier during the run.
After Rebirth you now gain a permanent +10% EXP bonus, helping you to level up quicker.
Hermes’ Sandals now also increase Dodge chance (on top of movement speed), allowing you to avoid enemy attacks.
Bosses gained partial resistance to Poison, as Poison was melting them too fast.
Structure damage scaling over time has been reduced - turret-style builds were scaling too hard in longer runs.
Improved damage feedback so hits are clearer and easier to read in the chaos.
Pandora’s Box event now has a short delay before champions spawn after you enter the circle, giving you a moment to reposition.
Rebirth achievement reward description now clearly mentions the extra Power slot reward.
Manual Aim support added for Paris’ Talent “Arrow in the Heel”.
[p align="start"]We hope you are doing well in 2026 - and as always, we are waiting for your feedback. A few notes before we go:
Console versions will jump straight from 1.2 to 1.4 - we’re sorry for the delay, fortunately we are slowly preparing the new update for the release as we speak.

We’re currently working hard on our third game, Brightfall - (if you are into open world survival craft games, we encourage you to check it out ☺️)… that being said, we have more planned for Achilles this year, so stay tuned! [dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/2850290/Brightfall/"]
Toruń has been hit with one of those “why do we live here again” cold snaps lately, so if these patch notes smell faintly of hot cocoa - that’s on us.
Happy Lunar New Year, everyone 🧧 From Toruń to wherever you’re reading this - stay warm, stay safe, and thank you for being here with us.
[p align="start"]And for the people who read everything: you’ll see a mini update before Easter 🤫
[p align="start"]
[p align="start"]Let us know how you are doing and what do you want us to tackle next!
[p align="start"]With warm regards,
[p align="start"]~Dark Point Games team

items.text: Survivors,

The air feels different this week. Perhaps it’s the chill of autumn sweeping through Toruń, or perhaps it’s the wind from Tartarus itself creeping through the cracks between worlds. The fires burn lower, and the scent of smoke and carved pumpkin mixes strangely with ash.
We’d call it a seasonal bug, but no. This time, it’s definitely a trick by Hades himself.

To celebrate mortals’ curious habit of mixing fear with laughter, the Lord of the Dead has twisted the Basements into a grotesque parody of harvest cheer. What once hid secrets of the underworld now brims with pumpkins - foul, grinning things that spitting at anything that moves.
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45195884/0ec47a4923eeb2be43d85a8a8daeb4f9137e2931.gif"]
Fear not, though. The spell will fade in a week’s time, and the pumpkins will return to whatever corner of the Underworld they escaped from.
Yet not everything will vanish.

In his strange generosity, Hades has allowed a few of his servants to stay. These skeletons, risen from Tartarus and crowned with pumpkins in place of heads, have decided to fight for you instead of against you. You can find them in the Workshop and enlist them to aid you in your next run.
Consider it a treat from the God of the Dead himself.
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45195884/529a77e4649f194baf76d857cf150c565cf31c7f.gif"]
Explore the pumpkin-filled Basements before they disappear next week.
Recruit your skeletal allies and let them rattle beside your Myrmidons.
Enjoy the eerie calm while it lasts… The dark never stays quiet for long.
Whether you are fighting the undead in Tartarus or watching the mist roll over the river here in Toruń, we wish you a hauntingly good Halloween.
Stay warm, Survivors. It's so cold here ːzoteː
~ The Dark Point Games Team
Hello, Survivors!

We’ve been hard at work these past few weeks, combing through your feedback and chasing down the most reported issues. Update 1.2 is a smaller patch, but it brings something for everyone: a new endgame feature, a golden new structure, and plenty of fixes and quality-of-life tweaks.

For those of you who already maxed out the Favour tree, there is now a new challenge. You can sacrifice all that progress in exchange for an extra Power slot, opening up new build possibilities and pushing your late-game runs even further.
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45195884/aaf8d8643cb3a3147ad821cb0662e501d2d21b54.png"]
What’s better than gold? More gold!
That’s why our new structure, Midas Statue, can transform enemies into gold… and make them drop Gold when slain.
You asked for more clarity and smoother play, so here’s what we added:
Kamikaze enemies now play a distinct sound effect. They are easier to notice and a bit more fun to dodge.
Hold time shortened when using reroll, so you get back to action sooner.
Added new on-screen tips to help explain options and mechanics, so new and returning players learn faster.
You can now leave the Workshop with ESC, which makes navigating menus quicker.
Dodge cap introduced: Player Dodge has been capped to preserve challenge. Say goodbye to your immortal builds…
Shield Throw buffed: Higher damage and longer duration make the Power more comparable with the rest.
Scaling adjusted for Locus of Repulsion so it remains useful without overwhelming other tools at high levels.
Status Strength improvements are now available for Pronomus’ Power from the start.
Blades of Madness upgraded: Starts with 3 blades (up from 2), with higher damage and a slightly longer duration for stronger crowd control.
Reduced Wrath of Ares cooldown so the Power feels more dynamic during fights.

notes.title: And of course, plenty of fixes to make your runs smoother

items.text: The Workshop no longer breaks after very long sessions.
Enemies killed by Myrmidons spawned from the Trojan Horse now properly count toward the “enemies killed by buildings” objective on Greece Map 4.
Fixed cases where some attacks collided with incorrect objects in The Chambers of Bridges.
Corrected French localization for clearer UI and descriptions.
Removed the Rift circle objective element. This now matches how event-spawned Rifts behave, improving consistency.
Fixed uneven ground on one location that could cause movement issues.
Corrected Medusa Statue category color to Support, matching its true category.
On ultrawide monitors, the event countdown seconds no longer overlap the minimap.

notes.title: One last note for our console players

items.text: the PlayStation and Xbox updates are almost done cooking. Once testing and store certification are complete, those versions will jump straight to 1.2, bringing all the content from Updates 1.1 and 1.2 in one go. We are also wrapping up work on the Nintendo Switch, which will launch directly with 1.2 so everyone starts on equal footing.
Beside working on updates, we’ve been sneaking in some time with Silksong ːsilksongː. Team Cherry did it again, "just one more try on this boss... One more, I promise..."
\[Cut to a clock showing 4 AM]
ːshermaː
Thank you for being here with us. We can’t wait to see you all on the battlefield, no matter where you play. It’s getting very autumn-y here in Poland, but of course your support keeps us warm. 💙
~Dark Point Games Team

items.text: Survivors -
we didn’t want you waiting long.

It’s been just over two weeks since the full release of Achilles: Survivor, and you’ve already filled our Discord, reviews, and inboxes with feedback. Some of it was praise (thank you 💙), some was bug reports (thank you, too!), and plenty was “can you please fix this now?”
The answer is “yes, of course, we will try our best!”

So we rolled up our sleeves, grabbed a pot of molten gold from King Midas’ vault, and forged Update 1.1 as quickly as we could. Almost every change you’ll read here comes directly from your comments and ideas.
Fire golden projectiles from both sides of your Survivor, slicing through enemies with style worthy of a king’s treasury.

King Midas was said to turn everything he touched into gold - an extraordinary gift that became his curse. In Achilles: Survivor, his tears fell heavy, each drop carrying the weight of his regret, and the power to destroy what they touched. Those tears take form of bright, golden projectiles from both sides of your Survivor, cutting through enemy ranks.
Their radiant arcs make them perfect for sweeping aside entire groups and keeping the battlefield clear on every flank. This power is available for all Survivors.
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45195884/8503b9659cd61c38de39126b4738eb009a7776d8.gif"]
Now fully supported in menus, UI, and gameplay - welcome to the battlefield, Survivors from Portugal and Brazil!
Our first priority was to address the most frustrating, game-breaking moments - like getting stuck in buildings or dealing with those kamikaze enemies you’ve told us so much about.
Added a Pause Menu “Unstuck” button so you can instantly free yourself if you get trapped by buildings or terrain.
Made Kamikaze enemies easier to spot and reduced their damage so they’re still dangerous, but no longer punishingly unfair.
Gave mid-bosses a small chance to drop the Magnetic Harp, making those fights more rewarding.
Added a progress bar for timed events so you know exactly when the next one will start, plus a toggle in settings if you prefer a cleaner screen.
Made event and stone deposit icons on the minimap flash briefly when they appear so you can react faster.
Added a “How to Play” reminder popup before your first run so new players know where to find tips - shown only once, so it won’t annoy you.
Added controller vibration when you take damage so hits feel more impactful.
The Basement and Rift circles caused too much confusion, so we replaced them with timers so you instantly understand how those mechanics work.
Added E and Q keyboard shortcuts to scroll tabs left and right, so you can navigate menus faster without touching the mouse.
Many of you told us the UI made it harder to play than it should be, so we’ve cleaned it up and made key information easier to find at a glance.
Added a visual marker to Favours that are ready to be claimed, so you’ll instantly know when a new one is available.
Reordered pause/summary screen stats so the most important info is easier to find.
Added an option to let you check your current Powers directly from the improvement or transformation selection screens, helping you make better upgrade choices.
Improved visibility of Power tags (Range, Strike, etc.) so you can compare abilities more easily.
Added clear seconds indicators to Structure Invulnerability so you know exactly how long the effect lasts.
Revealed the titles of locked Survivors so achievements make more sense and both Achilles variants are easier to tell apart.
Moved event start popups to match boss warning placement so they’re more noticeable.
Objective tuning: Lowered requirements for some of the most demanding objectives so they still require effort, but less luck.
Forge: Increased durability so it will last you longer in battle.
Statue of Medusa output: Increased cooldown, with further increases for each additional Statue built, to keep resource gains balanced over time.
Agamemnon’s Wrath: Reduced cooldown from 15s to 11s so you can use it more often.
Fixed an issue where Myrmidons could get stuck and stop fighting. They now work as intended and will support you in battle instead of slacking off.
Fixed collision in the Medusa Statue that could trap players.
Corrected names and icons for several Steam achievements (Conquest of Endless Troy, Conquest of Endless Dungeons, Conquest of Endless Mountain Fortress).
Fixed incorrect first-level value for the Enchanter’s “Greed of Enchanter” Favour.
Fixed Magical Overload for Enchanter so it properly increases your cooldown speed.
Damage numbers above 2.1 billion now display correctly.
Changed Medusa building category from “Turret” to “Support” so it’s listed properly.
Various language fixes in Polish, Chinese, and French.

Thank you for the incredible launch, for every comment, and for sticking with us through the bumps along the way. In just two weeks, you’ve helped shape Achilles: Survivor more than we could have alone.

With Update 1.1, we’re also introducing the Supporter Pack - a small, purely cosmetic DLC forged in the spirit of King Midas. Just as his touch turned all it met into gold, this pack gives every Survivor a shimmering golden skin and places a unique supporter’s badge in your main menu.
Your support helps us keep updating Achilles: Survivor, move our next project forward, and bring new worlds from our little studio in Toruń to your screen ❤️
[dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3950710/Achilles_Survivor__Supporter_Pack/"]
If that’s not your thing, that’s perfect too - your trust already means more than gold to us.
Keep telling us what works, what frustrates you, and what you dream of seeing next. Every run you play helps us make the next one better.
See you on the battlefield, Survivors!
~ Dark Point Games Team

releases.displayName: 🛠️ Crash Fix for Latest Nvidia Drivers is Here!

items.text: Hi Survivors,
We finally have good news for everyone who’s been running into crashes with the latest Nvidia drivers - and a working solution!
Just go to Steam launcher as you normally would
Select DirectX 11 as your launch option
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45195884/681a9332ab4ee9654fc034f0372169a3a9a0db5c.png"]
3. Press Play and (hopefully) enjoy a crash-free session!
Several players have already reported that this helped them finally get back into the game - so we hope it works for you too. 💙
We are truly sorry for the issues you faced.

It’s not the first chapter we wanted for version 1.0. But while we were wrestling with the problem, you were right there with us - sharing reports, testing possible fixes, and cheering us on when the battlefield felt uphill.
This fix wouldn’t have happened so quickly without one person in particular:
GothicTinus from our Discord, who sent us detailed logs, helped us pinpoint the issue, and tested out the solution.
Your deeds will echo through Olympus - thank you!

We also want to thank everyone in the Fatal Error Steam discussions thread (and everyone else affected) for reporting the issues they faced, testing out our ideas and being patient with us when we tried to find a solution.
And of course… a quiet thanks to Nvidia for their perfect timing...
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45195884/4f6bc5990b92e68c2ebb2f90a436ec4abb7ecf85.png"]
We can finally rest a bit easier tonight, and next week we will be back full force with new fixes and improvements to the game 😊
~Dark Point Games team
Hello Survivors,
We’ve just released a second hotfix to improve your experience after the 1.0 launch. Today’s changes focus on clarity, performance, and those elusive achievements:
✅ Determination VIII & IX - Fixed for 0.6 saves
If you’ve continued from an Early Access save, these two achievements should now track properly.
✅ FPS limit
To help people that reported their GPUs overheating, we set the FPS limit to default.
You can of course adjust it freely in settings!
✅ Ray Tracing Toggle
More graphic settings: Ray Tracing can now be turned on and off in the settings.
✅ Clearer Side Objective Description
We’ve updated the confusing challenge text: “Build a forge and transform any power” to “Raise any power to level 5 and build the forge.”
Clearer. Hopefully less frustrating.
✅ Spelling & Description Fixes
No more “Enchaters” in your menus - we’ve corrected a bunch of minor typos and weird phrasing across UI elements.
We’re still actively working on a fix for the crash issue affecting some players, especially those using the latest NVIDIA drivers.
If this is happening to you, we’d be incredibly grateful for your help:

👉 Join our Discord https://discord.com/invite/H7HEfABP9U and ping or DM Roni in this thread - Discord - Group Chat That’s All Fun & Games - we’re gathering logs from affected players in a private crash channel. Every report helps us move faster.
In the meantime, turning off Ray Tracing might be worth a try while we work on the proper fix.
💬 Final Words
These fixes wouldn’t be possible without your feedback - thank you to everyone who left a review, message, or bug report this week.
At the end, we want to give a special shoutout to one person in particular:
Huge thanks to Exo from our Discord. From the very start, they reported the Determination achievement bug, kept us updated, and even shared their save file to help us test the fix.
Your help made a real difference - thank you for being a part of our journey 💙
~Dark Point Games Team
Hi, Survivors!
A bit of good news today - we’ve just released Hotfix 1.0.1 to tackle some of the biggest issues reported after launch.
✅ Save loss issue is (hopefully) fixed
With this update, your saves should now safely sync with Steam Cloud, even if the game closes unexpectedly.
And remember - if this has happened to you, we are here for you! Come by our Discord and we’ll recover your save: Steam Community .
✅ No more getting stuck in buildings
You can no longer get trapped inside a structure if you're standing in its preview (ghost) form while it's being built.
✅ Determination VIII & IX achievements
These should now track progress correctly for everyone.
✅ Anti-aliasing option now works
Disabling anti-aliasing in the settings now correctly takes effect.
✅ Manual Aim label removed

We’ve removed the “not recommended” tag next to the Manual Aim setting - it’s working well enough now that we’re confident in letting you decide for yourself. (It’s cosmetic only, nothing about the system changed.)
✅ Credits added
We’ve updated the in-game credits and want to sincerely apologize to our team members whose names were missing before 😅 Thank you for your work - and your patience.

We’re actively working on a fix for the crash issues caused by the latest NVIDIA driver update. Thank you for your patience - we know how frustrating this is. In the meantime, you can find a temporary workaround here:
Steam Thread: Fatal Error after updating drivers
We’re also gathering feedback on what you’d like us to focus on next. Balance changes? New content? More QoL improvements? We want to hear what’s important to you!
We hope this hotfix makes your experience smoother 😊 Let us know if the game works better for you now!
~Dark Point Games Team

releases.displayName: The Final Battle Begins - Full Release Update Is Here

items.text: Survivors!
You thought you could escape my wrath.

You fought your way through scorched coastlines, blood-soaked battlefields, and cursed fortresses - each run a desperate step toward freedom. But every path, every escape, always led you back to where it all began -

to me.: And now, there’s nowhere left to run.: [img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45195884/f5f3f748cb5b322859d4f4e9f6b9fe047a00c92b.png"]: Descend into the Depths of Tartarus and face your greatest challenge yet.: No more second chances.: Will you let the gods define your fate… or make a last stand against the one who started it all?: We're in the Endgame now.

notes.title: 🎉 Achilles: Survivor leaves Early Access today.

items.text: Version 1.0 brings more changes than all previous updates combined: you’ll face new horrors in a twisted realm, test your strength in Endless Mode, gain new powers, and unlock four powerful new Survivors - each with their own unique playstyle.
Read on to discover what’s waiting for you in version 1.0.
And maybe grab a jug of tea - or ambrosia - because it’s a lot.

notes.title: 🌍 New Realm: Dungeons. Explore the Depths of Tartarus.

items.text: Venture into the darkest corners of the underworld in our brand-new fourth realm.
Dungeons are no ordinary prison - the souls of condemned bandits and terrifying creatures roam among the ruined structures, allowing no Survivor to escape without a fight.
You’ll face new, terrifying enemies, deadly midbosses, and powerful Overlords in six narrow, labyrinthine locations that leave little room to run… and nowhere to hide.
What lies in wait within the Depths of Tartarus?
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45195884/7ef9d634480417ebda04d47ddc1c8396195ae967.gif"]

notes.title: 🛠️ New Feature: Endless Mode. Prepare for Endless Pain

items.text: Your adventure with Achilles can now last forever… Or at least as long as your skills allow.
Every realm now has its own Endless variant, perfect for pushing your build to its limits. Survive as long as you can (and let us know your best time 💙)
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45195884/b287ffc64ce6ed9caa4fe6122121453dc81cfe21.png"]

notes.title: 🛠️ New Feature: Talents. Unlock a unique ability for each Survivor

items.text: Each Survivor has gained a unique Talent - a passive ability that differentiates them from other characters.

It’s one of the biggest changes in 1.0, designed to make each run feel more distinct, and each Survivor more… themselves. For example, Diomedes - king of Argos, said to have founded ten cities before he died - gains bonus building speed with each completed structure and recovers some missing health.
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45195884/9c501d4303c22bcbe3e4fb175d0e41200dd1d618.gif"]
The Favour system has been overhauled!
You’ll now experience more meaningful build variety as each class feels more distinct - with new specialization paths and modifiers.
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45195884/6f02a866b185bced582398d166180d4d34c5898f.png"]
→ Fast striking speed, high mobility and dodge chance. An assassin who strikes from the shadows.
A silent killer forged in the fires of war.

Achilles was once the shining hero of Greece - commander of the Myrmidons, unstoppable on the battlefield, and a demigod whose name echoed across the Aegean. But that man died in Troy. What returned from the underworld is something else entirely.
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45195884/53014698c3fe491efe178bf34ac9b2ccbb2a829d.gif"]
Now wearing the very armor in which he slew Agamemnon, Achilles no longer leads legions. He moves alone - fast, deadly, and unseen until it’s far too late.
They call him… the Kingslayer.
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45195884/3d02daf218dcef4b667e09230ab774a48b56dfc7.gif"]
-> High armor, heavy damage, low mobility. Commands the battlefield through brute force.
A heavy-armored warlord delivering devastating melee strikes.

Agamemnon was never just a king - he was the king. Ruler of Mycenae, supreme commander of the Greek forces during the Trojan War, and the man whose word brought fire and ruin to the walls of Troy. His brother Menelaus may have had the grudge, but it was Agamemnon who turned it into war.
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45195884/6ae70e8efcd7fa229b8436b2530031cb88154d18.gif"]
Don’t expect elegance - his movement is slow, and his strategy relies on overwhelming force.

Feared by his allies, hated by his enemies, and too proud for the gods themselves, Agamemnon led through dominance and blood. Now, ripped from the underworld and clad in iron heavier than his conscience, he returns as a force of pure aggression.
His thirst for power has only grown.
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45195884/ce2783b84f49a5d2266211eb788758bc86f1fbff.gif"]
→ Slow movement, high power, high armor. A walking tank who turns the battlefield into a demolition site.
A living relic of the old gods.

Steropes is one of the Elder Cyclopes - the children of Gaia and Uranus, ancient blacksmiths who once forged the thunderbolts of Zeus. In the depths of Hephaestus’ forge, he shaped weapons that would shatter mountains. Now, he brings that same force to the battlefield.
He doesn’t move fast. He doesn’t need to.
As a tank, he trades speed for overwhelming strength and heavy armor. Every strike lands like a forge hammer - slow to wind up, but absolutely crushing.
He has one eye. Two fists. And zero patience.
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45195884/b2dbff194b5d360f16de04cfcd26e4ed316766da.gif"]
→ High mobility, high crit chance, lower shooting damage. A fast, unpredictable fighter who blends martial skill with magical trickery.
He’s not part of this pantheon - but he wasn’t going to let that stop him.

Nezha is a legendary hero from Chinese mythology - a rebellious celestial warrior born of a lotus flower, known for defying divine orders and rewriting his own fate. Armed with enchanted relics and impossible speed, he’s outpaced demons, dragons, and now even death itself.
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45195884/c94458cc312d0f4807bd4079097c84c1a66c6afc.gif"]

On the battlefield, Nezha is a blur. He strikes with a fire-tipped spear, controls crowds with his Heavenly Sash, and moves like a storm on his signature Wind Fire Wheels. He may lack long-range firepower, but when it comes to close-quarters combat, few can match his precision and flair.
Most heroes try to escape Tartarus.
Nezha ran straight in - not to join the fight, but to stir it up.
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45195884/160111f55f29ad6e3a80dfcb0976004e4f9c9597.gif"]
Call upon the Lord of the Sea to unleash a mighty wave.
Poseidon sends a powerful surge forward, knocking back enemies in front of the Survivor. Great for creating breathing room - or wiping the battlefield clean.
This structure lashes out at nearby enemies with two rotating axes that extend and spin at regular intervals. Deals damage and applies light knockback - perfect for crowd control.
One glance and your foes freeze. You get paid.

Enemies that die to this cursed statue have a chance to turn to stone - and be converted directly into bonus Stone for your run. Build it smart, and let the Gorgon's gaze fund your construction empire.
Prepare for very different nightmares, as new Overlords \[Hades, Chimera], Midbosses \[Satyr, Centaur] and normal enemies join the battlefield.
What’s more, cyclops and spider Midbosses gained some special attacks - now all the Midbosses in the game have them.
Plenty of new challenges to chase down.
To make your life easier, we also introduced achievement filtering in this update.
Lowered building and mining times in Short Mode to improve pacing and lower frustration.
3 new improvements and tags were added: related to distance, melee, magic.
Bosses in Hard Mode now deal less damage, making it more probable to survive… But never certain.
Critical Hit Chance improvements were nerfed, as they were too powerful. The Trojan Horse structure received a minor nerf (now it grants 3% crit chance). Monument of Thunder was adjusted too.
Several characters were rebalanced and received changes to their passives.
Stone Golems now drop more Stone, befitting their name.
Graphic settings now save properly between sessions.
“Kill inside circle” objectives now only depend on whether you’re actually inside the circle, instead of being based on enemies' placement.
Manual Aim now works correctly in the Lava realm.
Ranged enemies and their projectiles are now easier to spot in combat. Same for the Myrmidons.
Summary screen now includes damage caused by statuses.
You should no longer get stuck on power transformation screen.
Fixed a rare bug where you could get stuck inside structures. There is no place to hide now.
And much more!

There’s always a bit of fear in releasing a game into the world. You never know what players will love, what they’ll demand with each update (Endless Mode was a long time coming…), or what will quietly crash in the background while you sleep during the release (broken saves on day one, anyone? We hope no one here remembers).
But over the past months, you’ve helped shape Achilles: Survivor into something we’re truly proud of.
Got rid of 863 bugs,
Added Survivors, realms, powers, game modes, and more than a few spiders to the game,
Survived reading thousands of comments, reviews, and Discord messages (thank you!)
What’s next?
Well, that’s a question for another day. Today, we celebrate (and stay ready in case something breaks. Gotta love working in gamedev).
Thank you for being here with us. We hope you enjoy 1.0 - and everything still to come.
All the best from Toruń 💙
~Dark Point Games Team
PS: If you’ve read this far… we’ve got a challenge for you.
To celebrate version 1.0 and the arrival of Endless Mode, we’re running a Discord competition.
🎯 Survive as long as you can on Endless Greece Coastline and post a screenshot in the right channel.
Winners will earn a digital copy of one of our games, for any platform.
▶ Full rules in the #survivor-news channel on Discord!
Good luck - and don't die too fast.

items.text: Hi, Survivors!
Quick hotfix today with a few improvements based on your feedback:
You’ll now see which difficulty you’ve cleared each map on - perfect for tracking your achievement progress.
This now correctly counts both physical and status-based powers (poison, fire, etc.).

notes.title: 📈 Final rewards scaling per difficulty now works correctly

items.text: Easy: no bonus
Normal: +20%
Hard: +50%
Thanks to those of you who flagged this - previously, Hard difficulty was giving the same rewards as Normal. The gods can be harsh, but not that unfair. Let us know if you spot anything else!
Hope you have an amazing week - it finally feels like summer here in Toruń, and we’re sending you some of that sunshine wherever you are. ~Dark Point Games Team
Hey Survivors!
Hope you’re feeling brave (and fireproof), because this one’s hot.
Update 0.6 is live - and it’s our biggest yet, forged in the fire of your feedback (Mount Doom has nothing on it) and hundreds of hours of coding, testing and fixing.
It’s going to be a long one; you’re going to need a jug full of coffee this time around ☕
Deep below the mortal world, beyond the reach of sea winds and sunlight, rises a fortress carved into the bones of a living volcano.
Its walls glow with molten veins. Its halls echo with the chants of Hades' sworn-cultists who traded their souls for power, and now worship death with every breath.
In other words: our third realm is here, and it’s full of lava. What to expect?
Explore five handcrafted locations in the heart of a volcanic peak.
Face new, tougher enemies & bosses.
Don’t forget to enjoy the views!

notes.title: 🕷️ New Survivor: Phalanx, the Venomous Spider

items.text: Cursed and twisted by Athena for defying the gods, reborn with eight limbs and venomous fangs, he is a fast, lethal predator that weaves poison into every encounter.
Meet Phalanx, the Venomous Spider.
He’s fast. He’s deadly. He’s got way too many legs.

Winner of our community vote, Phalanx, joins the Survivor roster with increased power range, critical chance, and movement speed, striking enemies from afar with volleys of poisonous thorns. Take a look at him in action:
This was, without a doubt, your #1 request.
Not everyone has 20 uninterrupted minutes. Some of you have families. Others have fatigue or health issues. And a few of you just really like intense, compact bloodbath.
That’s why every realm now supports a short-run mode. Choose your location. Play for 10 minutes. Win, lose, repeat, it's up to you.
You asked for more difficulty. And also less difficulty. So… we did both.
Easy – great for casual runs.
Normal – Former default, balanced challenge.
Hard – Unlocks after your first clear. Proceed with caution.
Yes, you can switch anytime. No, we won’t judge. We’ve all been humbled by a flaming plant before.
New faces, same goal: send you back to Tartarus. Alongside new normal enemies, we’ve added four new bosses and midbosses - each designed to test your builds and reflexes.
Each of his steps is an earthquake. A towering guardian forged by the gods, Talos, now stalks the Mountain Fortress.
Greece is his domain, and he is not happy to see you. Agamemnon brings tactical aggression to the battlefield. He punishes hesitation, and doesn’t go down easy.
Don’t let him fool you. One charge from this hunk of enchanted rock can flatten you.
If a flamethrower grew roots and hated you personally, this would be it. We’ve heard you loved plants, so we thought “how about a bigger one that shoots multiple projectiles at you?”.
New location objective - win by closing a massive, unstable Rift - a portal pumping out elite enemies non-stop.
Your goal: hold the line long enough to shut it.
Your tools: whatever you managed to scrounge together on this run.
Your odds?
… Good luck!

If you clear Hard Mode, the gods will actually be impressed. They may even grant you Divine Crystals as a prize. Using Divine Crystals, you can unlock higher Favour tiers and finally reach your full potential.
Want more stone?
Now you’ve got it.
Two shiny new pickaxe tiers can now drop mid-run, giving you bonus stone for building.
That’s not a typo.

notes.title: We made life (and death) just a little easier

items.text: New ‘unseen’ markers highlight powers, structures, and transformations you haven’t tried yet.
Restart from Summary screen: Quickly replay the same setup with one click.
New Transformation icons: selected transformation icons are now more unique and better reflect their function.
Disconnecting your controller now reliably pauses the game.
Building damage now scales with location level so turrets & traps remain relevant in later stages.
Re-tuned Transformation and Improvement bonuses. Added/removed certain Transformations to keep your builds fresh.
Titan’s Blade & Shield Throw gain the Cursed Gods Transformation that will give you more options to apply Curse to enemies, making it easier to complete related achievements.
Armour values on Hector and Achilles re-balanced.
3 older achievements adjusted for smoother pacing.
Max-level Favours now properly display their bonuses.
Gold spent in Workshops counts toward statistics and Spend Gold objective.
Fire Axes now reliably apply burn.
Cursor visibility improved.
50 additional minor fixes including UI polish, language tweaks and various other topics.

So many of the changes in 0.6 were shaped by your feedback, votes, and comments. We’re a small team, still figuring things out, trying to make something special - and it means the world to have you along for the ride.

notes.title: If you feel like chatting, tell us in the comments

items.text: What’s your favorite part of the update?
What would you love to see next?
And hey - how are you doing on this beautiful (but cloudy) Wednesday?
~Dark Point Games team

notes.title: Survivors - it's time to burn it all down.

items.text: The battlefield just got a lot more dangerous (and a lot more fun).
Update 0.5 is one of our biggest yet: a mythic new Survivor, long-awaited feature, devastating new powers, divine structures, and more ways than ever to leave your enemies in ruins.
It’s a big one - so grab yourself a cup of tea, and let’s descend into the chaos together.

notes.title: 🏆 At Last: Steam Achievements are here!

items.text: You asked for it. We delivered.
Achievements are now fully integrated with Steam - and if you've already unlocked any, they'll automatically sync the next time you launch the game.
New ones are already waiting for you - can you catch them all?
The noble son of Iapetus outwitted him and stole the far-seen gleam of unwearying fire
— Hesiod, Theogony
He stole fire from Olympus. Now he’s fighting for you.
Prometheus is a high-risk, high-reward Survivor with low health and rapid regeneration. He burns enemies with every hit using his unique Power: Fire Breath.
Fire Breath
Exhale pure destruction. Prometheus’s signature move scorches the battlefield (and your enemies) with a cone of flame.
Souls of Tartarus
Summon the damned. Cursed spirits rise from the underworld, latching onto enemies and tearing them apart with dark energy.
Monument of Thunder
A divine turret that channels Zeus himself. It strikes enemies near you, no matter where it’s built.
Dart Thrower
A circle of death. This construct fires high-speed darts in all directions, piercing through enemies like butter.
Spike Trap
Stop enemies dead in their tracks. Lay brutal spike traps - enemies who step on it get a face full of Olympus-grade steel.

notes.title: 💰 4 New Favours: Choose Your Divine Blessing

items.text: Need a stronger start? Four new Favours have been added to expand your options:
Patience Pays Off - Start with higher Status Strength
Plutus’ Generosity - Begin each run with extra gold
Gaia’s Blessing - Gain bonus stone at the start
Passionate Miner - Increases mining speed and yields more stone per cycle

notes.title: 🛠️ 5 Major Balance & Quality of Life Improvements

items.text: Achievement progress is now displayed in-game, making it easy to track how much you are missing.
The “How to Play” tab now shows you stats for all powers.
Apollo’s Light (Pythia’s power) has been improved: orbs orbit closer to you for better control.
Selected transformation icons are now more unique and better reflect their function.
Structures now visibly react to damage.
Moirai Thread power got a buff (and a new transformation)
Striking Speed got a much needed nerf (yes, you were overpowered - we saw you).
Achievement grind reduced - The Power of Magic and I Just Want to Fight now unlock with fewer runs.
Visual effects now display correctly on all eight-legged abominations.
Your thrown shield will now reliably return to you. As it should.
Minor performance improvements and optimizations.
Seven new achievements have also been added with this update: A builder, Bones bones bones, Pyromaniac, Experienced Marksman, It’s a Trap, Unforgivable Curse, Architect.
To all our new Survivors from Korea and Japan —
Welcome to the battlefield.
We’re proud to bring full language support in this update. Let us know what you think and how we can make it even better.
Your dedication deserves a reward.
We’re running a community vote for the next Survivor on our Discord server. Want to shape the future of the game? Now's your chance.
Every spark of this update came from you.
From bug reports to bold ideas, your feedback helps us shape the world of Achilles: Survivor - one update at a time.

Our games come from a deep love for ancient myths and joy of gaming. We are so happy to share it with you. Seeing this community grow with us has been humbling, motivating, and honestly? Kind of epic.
What’s your favorite part of this update? Let us know in the comments below!
See you on the battlefield,
(or our Discord server).
~Dark Point Games team

items.text: Hello, Survivors!
We're excited to announce a major update to Achilles: Survivor, bringing new features and improvements based on your feedback. Let's dive into what's new!

You asked, we delivered! Now you can aim your attacks with precision using your cursor. Choose to aim only your Main Power or all Powers, switchable at any time. This feature gives you more control over your gameplay, allowing you to target enemies strategically rather than just attacking the nearest foes.

Not thrilled with the available transformations? Now you can sacrifice a transformation to select an additional improvement instead. This new option provides greater control over your build, allowing for more diverse and personalized playstyles.
Champions: Prepare to face new mid-bosses that will appear randomly throughout your runs. With their unique attack patterns, these Champions will put your skills to the test!
Regular Enemies: The battlefield has become more diverse with the addition of new regular enemies, adding fresh challenges to your survival runs.

We've noticed some transformations were less popular than others. In response, we've added 7 new transformations to existing powers, designed to have a more significant impact on gameplay. Get ready for some exciting new strategies!
Two new powers join the fray: Battering Ram and Moirai's Thread. These additions will open up even more interesting ways to play the game. The more, the merrier!
While you could find game mechanics explanations on our Steam forum, we've now added a comprehensive "How to Play" section directly in the main menu for easy access to all the information you need.
Calling all completionists! We've added new achievements for those who love to collect them all. Challenge yourself to unlock these new milestones!

We're thrilled to bring you these updates and can't wait to see how they enhance your Achilles: Survivor experience. Thank you for your continued support and feedback – it's invaluable in helping us improve the game.
Get ready to dive back into the action with these exciting new features. See you on the battlefield, survivors!

Hello, Survivors!
Thank you for your continued support and enthusiasm for our game during this Early Access period!

We're thrilled to see so many of you enjoying the mythological world we've created. Our development team is working tirelessly to ensure your experience is as smooth as possible. As soon as we learned about the Steam Cloud save synchronization issues, it immediately became our top priority, which is why we were able to deliver this fix so quickly.

We're pleased to announce that Hotfix 0.2.2 is now live, addressing this problem. After installing this update, your saves should automatically synchronize to the most recent version across all your devices using Steam Cloud.
Please note that in some cases, Steam may detect inconsistencies between saves on different machines. If prompted, simply choose the most up to date save file to continue your progress.
We sincerely apologize for any inconvenience this issue may have caused. Rest assured, we're actively working on other aspects of the game based on your valuable feedback.

Hello Survivors!

First of all, a huge thank you to everyone playing "Achilles: Survivor" in Early Access! Your feedback on the Steam forums and Discord has been invaluable, and we truly appreciate your support and engagement.

One of our top priorities has been improving the game's performance. With this hotfix, we’ve implemented a solution that enhances stability and improves overall smoothness. This is just the beginning—performance optimization will continue as we refine the game further.

Shortly after launch, we noticed that some players with saves from the demo were unable to start the game. Reacting quickly was a top priority for us, and we managed to release a fix within just two hours after launch to resolve the issue.

This update is a rework of memory management for enemies. The previous system proved to be inefficient in later stages of the game, leading to performance drops. With this new approach, enemies are now handled more efficiently in memory, reducing unnecessary strain on the system and improving overall gameplay smoothness.

Improved overall game performance and stability depends on specific hardware and graphic settings average FPS increased by 15-40% (typically around 25-30%), 1% low FPS increased by 20-90%, ensuring smoother gameplay in demanding scenarios.
Fixed a possibility of getting stuck in the Trojan Horse after building it
Fixed a possibility of the game freezing while choosing transformations

Of course, this is just the beginning of our improvements. Early Access is a time for us to implement as many fixes, optimizations, and enhancements as possible. Our initial focus is on performance and bug fixes, after which we’ll shift towards developing additional content for the game. However, we want to ensure that every run delivers as much enjoyment as possible without unnecessary frustration caused by technical issues.
